intro: Lesson 27. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ (١١) إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ (١٢) يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ (١٣) بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ (١٤) وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ (١٥) لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ (١٦) إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ (١٧) فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ (١٨) ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ (١٩)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: No! There is no refuge. To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back. Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
Even if he presents his excuses. Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation. So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Qiyamah 75:11-19 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 75:11-19 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: «بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ» (75:14): why does بَلْ get a kasrah?
questions.a: Two sukoons meet with hamzat al-wasl
options: Two sukoons meet with hamzat al-wasl

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 75:11-19 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Link 75:16 to 19 to how we learn in class (talaqqi).
questions.a: We listen to the teacher first, then follow, then the teacher corrects: just as the Prophet ﷺ listened, then followed.

questions.q: What do 75:14 to 15 say about excuses on the Day?
questions.a: A person is a witness against himself, even if he brings excuses.

questions.q: 75:18 tells the Prophet ﷺ: when We have recited it ...
questions.a: A) then follow its recitation. 75:18: 'So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.'

questions.q: Think again: Allah told the Prophet ﷺ not to rush his tongue when receiving the Qur'an: 'upon Us is its collection' (75:16 to 17). What does this teach us about how to memorise?
questions.a: Listen first, then follow (75:18); trust Allah, be calm, do not rush.
